claims.statement: In March 1877 Tom Allen was in Canada, out of the way of those with warrants.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the champion bruiser, is over in Canada, out of the way of those fellows with warrants

claims.statement: Warrants were out for Tom Allen, and he stayed in Canada to avoid them.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the champion bruiser, is over in Canada, out of the way of those fellows with warrants

claims.statement: Tom Allen claimed he could beat Joe Goss.
claims.excerpt: But he says he can lick Joe Goss.

notes: The boast is the paper's paraphrase, not a direct quote.
